heading: Today
text: Morning clouds in the north diminishing by the afternoon, mostly sunny south. Highs in the 40s to near 50 north, in the low to mid 50s south. Northwest wind at 5 to 10 mph, occasionally gusting to 15 mph.

heading: Halloween
text: Morning clouds in the north diminishing by the afternoon, mostly sunny south. Highs in the 40s to near 50 north, in the low to mid 50s south. Northwest wind at 5 to 10 mph, occasionally gusting to 15 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear. Lows ranging from the low 20s in the cooler valleys to near 30 over the higher hills, and along Lake Champlain. Winds diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Sunday
text: Mostly sunny. Highs from the mid to upper 50s, nearing 60 in the warmer southern valleys. Light wind turning east at 5 to 10 mph.
